release.content: pubkit 0.26.0 was released on 2026-11-02 from commit 461b65d791b83f8d826af807e4291ec62e92aff0 with these changes.

rows: pubkit github-app create says which repositories a new installation reaches, all of them or the list of those selected, and links to where that is changed. The README notes that opening the install page may install the app on every repository straight away.
pubkit service-account-key create makes a Google Cloud service account key and puts it in Bitwarden with Bitwarden's SDK, so no file, command line or Terraform state ever holds it.
pubkit github-app create writes the app's key with Bitwarden's SDK, from memory, so it is no longer on a command line while it is written.

release.scope: the published release v0.26.0 of pubkit
